meta.title: Suggestion review queue — choose the best path before implementing
meta.review_rule: Nothing here is implemented. Every row is a proposal with its trade-offs and a recommended path. A reviewer marks a row Approved / Rejected / Deferred before any implementation session touches the referenced files (the same proposed -> approved gate used by the merged suggestions hub).

rows.proposal: Declare the root Line Lab the canonical site; treat sibling hubs as category archives and stop new parallel hubs
rows.expected_impact: One place for a reader to make decisions; ends the eight-way duplication (I-04)
rows.tradeoffs: Sibling labs contain deeper single-lab analysis; keeping them linked (not merged) preserves that depth at the cost of two click levels
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: root index.html as landing; add verify-hub/ (decisions) and the sibling labs to the archive page; log a board rule that new work extends existing labs instead of creating new roots

rows.proposal: Build ONE injury & depth-deficiency tracker (offense/defense, 1st-4th string) on the official weekly injury report plus inferred usage tiers
rows.expected_impact: Closes the only major requirement with no working implementation; enables injury-aware signals later
rows.tradeoffs: Depth strings must be inferred (no league source, VH-SRC-03): tiers are only as good as the usage rule and must be labelled inferred
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: one implementation (the decision-hub fetcher already exists) adopted repo-wide; weekly ingest before kickoff, blank depth-string cells where unverifiable, published on one injuries page

rows.proposal: Adopt a single validation-gate catalog and one holdout split for the whole competition
rows.expected_impact: Makes leaderboard rows comparable across labs; stops gate-cherry-picking
rows.effort: medium (merge root G1-G10 with quant G9 repricing and skill-lab G10 price provenance)
rows.tradeoffs: Re-scoring historical rows under one catalog may change some gate counts; old rows must keep their original labels
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: the merged 10-gate catalog in leaderboard.html (this hub) as the single rulebook; declare holdout = most recent 2 seasons, untouched until a run is frozen

rows.proposal: Publish one reward schedule, paper-labelled until funding exists
rows.expected_impact: Removes the four-schedule conflict (I-06); keeps the leaderboard honest
rows.tradeoffs: A paper schedule motivates less than cash; an unfunded cash-looking schedule is a misrepresentation
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: BDB-2027-style tiers (Gold 10/10 + skill score, Silver 10/10, Bronze 9/10 with mandatory G1/G3/G5/G6/G10), pool labelled 'paper points, not funded'; fund only via an explicit decision (Q-10)

rows.proposal: Keep stored-price-only settlement repo-wide and publish the exclusion counts with every ROI
rows.expected_impact: Prevents the issue-#19 class of error from returning anywhere (the wind-under edge dropped from +8.65% to +7.14% when imputed prices were removed)
rows.effort: low (already policy in two labs; extend the wording to all)
rows.tradeoffs: Smaller samples; some rows lose significance
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: make it a written rule in the gate catalog (G10 price provenance) and print n_excluded_missing_price next to every ROI

rows.proposal: Stamp every published number with its definition, window and as-of date
rows.expected_impact: Kills the QB-WR1 four-coefficient hazard (I-02) and the mixed as-of confusion (I-07)
rows.effort: medium (template change in generators + a definitions page)
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: a tooltip-free convention - each value cell carries 'r=0.614 (ex-post leader, 2018-2026, n=6,984, as-of 2026-11-02)' style labels

rows.proposal: Source-register hygiene sweep: mark dead URLs with retrieval dates, pin the active rulebook edition
rows.expected_impact: Two dead official URLs (VH-SRC-03, VH-SRC-05) and one archived rules edition are currently cited as live
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: each register entry gains last_checked_utc + status (live / dead / archived); CI prints any entry unchecked for 30 days

rows.proposal: Publish one 'Data & Definitions' dictionary mapping every metric to its formula, window and role labels
rows.expected_impact: Makes ex-ante vs ex-post, designation vs leader, team-game vs player-game unambiguous
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: single page generated from one JSON; every table value links its definition id

rows.proposal: Pre-register signal families in one file before any new test run
rows.expected_impact: Keeps the BH family definition honest; prevents post-hoc signal counts
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: a pre-registration.json per lab (hypothesis, market, window, direction, n) committed before the run; FDR family = all rows in that file

rows.proposal: Align refresh cadence: one weekly data refresh, one PR, one as-of stamp across labs
rows.expected_impact: Ends mixed-date pages; keeps the byte-compare audit (A-05) meaningful
rows.tradeoffs: Less ad-hoc freshness; automation token limits require PR-based publishing (already the post-#20 design)
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: the existing PR-based refresh workflow as the single entry point; every lab rebuilds from the same extracts in the same PR

rows.proposal: Consolidate the Q&A and flag registers cross-lab (this hub's registers as the triage layer)
rows.expected_impact: One reviewer view for questions, flags and suggestions instead of four divergent copies
rows.effort: low (this hub already aggregates; add links from the other hubs)
rows.tradeoffs: Labs lose some local register convenience
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: keep lab registers as the source, render this hub's pages from them at each release, and route review comments to COORDINATION.md

rows.proposal: Capital rule: no strategy goes live until it passes 10/10 gates on the untouched holdout at recorded prices, with controls re-run
rows.expected_impact: Guarantees the leaderboard stays skill-filtered; controls C1/C2 and STR-15/16 stay in every run
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: encode as the top rule of the leaderboard page and the executive summary

rows.proposal: Point-in-time discipline for injuries: only the report published before kickoff may be used; never update history retroactively
rows.expected_impact: Prevents lookahead leakage into injury features (the largest leakage risk in the requirement)
rows.tradeoffs: Storage of superseded reports; slightly more pipeline code
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: immutable append-only report store keyed by (week, team, published_at); features join on the latest report strictly before kickoff

rows.proposal: Price same-game parlays with the correlation-aware (copula) table; treat cross-game legs as approximately independent but disclose it
rows.expected_impact: Removes the systematic mispricing of correlated stacks (multipliers 1.26x-2.05x measured)
rows.effort: medium (pricing table already exists in two labs; unify)
rows.tradeoffs: Copula parameters drift by window; the table needs the same weekly refresh as the data
rows.recommended_path: Recommended: one copula pricing table generated with the weekly refresh; every parlay row shows both the naive and correlation-aware price
